binary_owner.local_source_status: current Cargo workspace does not list fleet-monitor; upstream destination only

user_shell_exclusion.ruling: Upstream/shared-binary responsibility; no local fork or cron patch in this unit.
user_shell_exclusion.evidence: monitor exposes pane_index token but no worker/agent_type/exclude/shell filter; tmux maps %70 idx=0 cmd=zsh and agent panes %74/%71/%73 cmd=cli.js
user_shell_exclusion.temporary_convention: Treat jev actionable output as workers-only and never dispatch pane_index=0/user command=zsh until upstream filter lands.
user_shell_exclusion.required_upstream_input: pane_current_command or agent_type/pane metadata at monitor decision time.

dry_queue.ruling: CONDUCTOR-SIDE, out of scope for the binary.
dry_queue.reason: The monitor can observe liveness and pane identity but cannot know the conductor packet or remaining unit count; idle-because-finished and idle-because-packet-exhausted require opposite responses.
dry_queue.required_input: Conductor packet/queue state carrying remaining units and receipt status.
dry_queue.remedy: Shared conductor packet/queue contract or upstream shared-binary integration only; never a jev-local fork.

cross_project_bead.observed: uds-ry5d recommended for a jev pane
cross_project_bead.ruling: Cross-project leakage; bead selection must be session-scoped or the monitor output must be treated as non-dispatchable.
cross_project_bead.owner: Upstream/shared monitor or conductor selection layer.

false_working.observed: pane %73 reported WORKING on timer_changed while idle
false_working.ruling: Liveness false positive attributed to spinner/timer content; upstream monitor needs a stable discriminator, not a local fork.

conclusion: Reject dry-queue support as a binary feature; file the user-shell and cross-project selection defects upstream/shared, and keep conductor-side packet state as the dry-queue owner.
no_claim: No binary patch, cron edit, upstream bead creation, or conductor queue tracker was performed.
